request: Inspect real DebugAI durable native model run status/step privately, retaining full JSON on Host only; return fixed status code.

bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; id=$(cat /tmp/debugai-pr112-e2e-run-id); test -n "$id"; curl -fsS --max-time 10 "http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/status/$id" >/tmp/debugai-pr112-e2e-status.json; jq -e '.schema=="debugai.run-status/v1" and .durable!=null' /tmp/debugai-pr112-e2e-status.json >/dev/null; jq -e '[.durable.job_status,.durable.workflow_cursor.step_id,.durable.last_execution_error]|all(.==null or type=="string")' /tmp/debugai-pr112-e2e-status.json >/dev/null; s=$(jq -r '.durable.job_status' /tmp/debugai-pr112-e2e-status.json); case "$s" in DONE) exit 43;; BLOCKED) exit 41;; FAILED) exit 44;; RETRY_WAIT) exit 42;; RUNNING|QUEUED|PAUSED) exit 0;; *) exit 45;; esac
